column1: # ZAP baseline rule tuning for the published calendar surface.
# Every IGNORE below is a finding that cannot be fixed by this application because it is a
# property of the deployment (a static build behind nginx) or of the protocol. Anything accepted
# here is also recorded in docs/security/findings.md with its reason and revisit trigger. A rule
# is never ignored because it is inconvenient.

column3: Re-examine Cache-control: the calendar route sets its own Cache-Control and ETag; ZAP flags the absence on 404s.
Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: the SPA bundle is minified by Vite, which strips comments.
Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set: CSP is added by the edge, not by the static index served inside the network.
Permissions Policy Header Not Set: added by the edge snippet.
Modern Web Application: informational only, no action possible or needed.
Storable and Cacheable Content: hashed build assets are immutable by design and must be cacheable; this rule would have them re-fetched on every visit.
CSP: style-src unsafe-inline: required by Tailwind and Vue runtime style injection. Scripts are never allowed inline, and tightening this would break the published layout.
Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy / Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: both headers are set by infra/edge/security-headers.conf; ZAP reports the 404 responses that do not carry them.
